Home.heroKicker: Mobile car valeting · We come to you
Home.heroTitle: Your car, immaculate. At your door.
Home.heroSub: Book a 2-hour slot, secure it with a small deposit and pay the balance online. At your home or workplace.
Home.how1t: Pick a service and a 2-hour slot
Home.how1d: Prices are shown for your vehicle size before you commit.
Home.how2d: Secures your slot. Reschedule free up to 24h before.
Home.how3d: Any time up to and on the day. No cash needed.
Home.alreadyBooked: Already booked? Open your booking with the link in your email or your reference.

Services.title: Services
Services.subtitle: Every service takes one 2-hour slot. Prices depend on vehicle size.
Services.addonNote: Add-ons are optional extras, priced per service.

Prices.title: Prices
Prices.subtitle: Pick your vehicle size. The price you see is the price you pay, plus any travel fee.
Prices.note: Deposit is non-refundable. Rescheduling is free until 24h before your slot.

Booking.s1note: Every service fills one 2-hour slot. You’ll see the exact price once you pick a vehicle size.
Booking.notSure: Not sure? Pick the larger size.
Booking.s4sub: We need a driveway or parking spot with access to the car.
Booking.notesPh: Gate code, where the car is parked, who to call…
Booking.travelNote: The travel fee is set per postcode and added to your total.
Booking.outOfAreaBlocked: We don’t serve this postcode yet. Try another, or contact us.
Booking.checkPostcode: Enter your postcode to check the travel fee.
Booking.s5sub: Only slots the owner has opened are shown. Your slot is held for 15 minutes while you pay.
Booking.noSlots: No open slots in the coming days.
Booking.s6sub: No account needed. We email you a private link to manage your booking.
Booking.phoneHelp: Used for WhatsApp updates from the owner.
Booking.emailHelp: Your confirmation and magic link go here.
Booking.agree: I understand the deposit is non-refundable and that I can reschedule for free until 24h before my slot.
Booking.errorSlotTaken: That slot was just taken. Please pick another.
Booking.errorOutOfArea: We don’t serve that postcode. Please change it.
Booking.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

BookingPending.title: Your slot is held
BookingPending.sub: We’ve held your slot for 15 minutes. Continue to payment to confirm your booking with a deposit.
BookingPending.b4Note: Payment (deposit + method picker) is wired in the next build step.

Checkout.methodsNote: Card via Stripe · Bancontact via Mollie
Checkout.error: Couldn’t start payment. Please try again.
Checkout.confirmedSub: Deposit received — your slot is booked.
Checkout.balanceSub: Pay the remaining balance any time up to the day.
Checkout.fullyPaidSub: Nothing left to pay. See you then.

BookingView.ratePrompt: How did we do? Your rating helps others.
BookingView.rateError: Could not send — please try again.

Find.title: Find my booking
Find.sub: Enter your reference and the email or phone you booked with.
Find.notFound: We couldn’t find a booking for that reference and contact. Check both and try again.

Email.confirmSubject: Your Nova Valet booking {reference} is confirmed
Email.confirmBody: Thanks — your deposit is received and your slot is booked. Booking {reference}.
Email.linkFallback: Or paste this link into your browser:

Admin.signInSub: Owner access only. Customers don’t need an account: they use the link in their email.
Admin.stripeSwap: Switch to live via environment keys.
Admin.noOpenSlots: No open slots to move to.
Admin.completeWarn: Completing with a balance outstanding is allowed but flagged.
Admin.cancelSub: The slot is released for someone else.
Admin.forfeitNote: The deposit is non-refundable. No further amount is charged; the outstanding balance is cleared.
Admin.tapHint: Tap a closed cell to open it; tap an open cell to close it. Booked and held cells can’t be closed.
Admin.createsN: Creates open slots across the chosen days and times. Booked or held slots are never overwritten; anything too close to another slot is skipped.
Admin.overlapSkipped: Skipped {n} that clashed with the 1-hour travel buffer.
Admin.invalid: Pick at least one day and one start time.
Admin.catSub: Edit services, sizes, prices, add-ons and the deposit. Changes go live immediately.
Admin.areaSub: Postcode prefixes and travel fees. Longest matching prefix wins; out-of-area blocks booking. Changes go live immediately.
Admin.homeSub: Hero text, the service-area line and the before/after photos. Changes go live immediately.
Admin.homeImageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP · max 5 MB
Admin.revSub: Customer testimonials shown on the homepage. Add only genuine reviews.
Admin.legSub: Privacy, terms and cookie text (per locale) plus your business details for the footer and invoices. Changes go live immediately.
Admin.paySub: Provider-verified payments (a read-only mirror — money truth is the provider).
Admin.custSub: Everyone who has booked (guest-only, grouped by email).

Wa.tConfirm: Hi {name}, this is Nova Valet about your booking {ref} on {slot} at {addr}. The outstanding balance of {bal} can be paid online via your link. See you then!
Wa.tReminder: Hi {name}, a reminder from Nova Valet: {slot} we come to {addr} for your {service}. Please make sure the car is accessible. See you soon!
Wa.tBalance: Hi {name}, the balance of {bal} for booking {ref} is still outstanding. You can pay it online via your link. Thank you!
Wa.tOnWay: Hi {name}, Nova Valet is on the way to {addr}. Please have the car accessible and the keys ready. See you very soon!
Wa.tConfirmPaid: Hi {name}, this is Nova Valet about your booking {ref} on {slot} at {addr}. You are all paid up — see you then!

Manage.noSlots: No open slots to move to right now.

Manage.forfeitNote: The deposit is non-refundable. No further amount is charged; the outstanding balance is cleared.

Manage.moveViaWhatsApp: Message us on WhatsApp to move it →
